# Rotaract South Asia MDIO Insights (Full Index)

> Expanded LLM-oriented map of Rotaract Insights: dashboards, REST API surfaces, MCP transports, connector listings, and policy pages. Use this when a shorter `/llms.txt` context is insufficient. Canonical host: https://insights.rsamdio.org.

Important notes for agents:

- Prefer `/ai-overview.md`, `/openapi.json`, and `/.well-known/mcp-server.json` over scraping large HTML tables.
- South Asia analytics are limited to Rotary International Zones 4, 5, 6, and 7.
- Worldwide routes and `/api/v1/worldwide*` endpoints cover global Rotary districts.
- Public REST and MCP access require no authentication.
- Dataset license is ODbL-1.0. Cite RSAMDIO Insights and the data-as-of date when quoting figures.
- Outstanding dues are shown in INR after club-level integer rounding. TRF values are USD.

## Core product pages

- [AI overview (Markdown)](https://insights.rsamdio.org/ai-overview.md): Authoritative factual brief for citation and tool routing
- [Home dashboard](https://insights.rsamdio.org/): Executive KPIs, filters, charts, leaderboards, drilldown tables
- [Worldwide statistics](https://insights.rsamdio.org/worldwide): Global Rotaract/Interact rankings and growth
- [API docs](https://insights.rsamdio.org/docs): Interactive REST reference
- [OpenAPI JSON](https://insights.rsamdio.org/openapi.json): Full REST schema
- [Contact](https://insights.rsamdio.org/contact): Human support and developer contact desk
- [Privacy](https://insights.rsamdio.org/privacy): Privacy and telemetry disclosures
- [Terms](https://insights.rsamdio.org/terms): License and usage terms

## REST API (high-value endpoints)

- [GET /api/v1/summary](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/summary): Executive South Asia or zone-scoped KPI summary
- [GET /api/v1/leaderboards](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/leaderboards): Top clubs, districts, arrears, and TRF rankings
- [GET /api/v1/districts](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/districts): District roster and performance indicators
- [GET /api/v1/clubs](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/clubs): Searchable Rotaract club roster
- [GET /api/v1/compliance](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/compliance): Arrears and missing-officer compliance datasets
- [GET /api/v1/opportunities](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/opportunities): Rotary clubs without Rotaract or Interact sponsorship
- [GET /api/v1/trf](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/trf): The Rotary Foundation contribution details
- [GET /api/v1/interact](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/interact): Interact ecosystem metrics
- [GET /api/v1/worldwide](https://insights.rsamdio.org/api/v1/worldwide): Worldwide summary metrics
